member.name: T:VectorNav.Communication.DeliminatedStream
member.summary:
Represents a Stream that sends deliminated commands. These commands can have a set of leading delimination characters that indicate the beginning of a commmand and also a set of ending delimination characters that indicate the end of a command.
Commands sent through this Stream will have the leading and ending delimination characters appended to the command before it is sent to the lower communication level. Incoming data from the lower communication level will be inspected and only those commands that are successfully deliminated will be sent to the higher communication level through the event. The event will only send one command at a time. The commands sent to the higher communication level will have all delimination characters removed.
